candidates.title: How to spot if a gift card has been tampered with before your purchase
candidates.is_short_evidence: GET /shorts/ZVQPxS16At0 returns HTTP 200 with no redirect. Control: /shorts/PNjdcz3eG9o and /shorts/_RTe-ddhxoY both 303-redirect to /watch, i.e. not Shorts.
candidates.orientation_method: two independent non-duration pixel reads: (a) yt-dlp format table — every video rendition portrait (fmt 137 1080x1920, fmt 248 1080x1920, fmt 136 720x1280); (b) ffprobe on the original-aspect-ratio thumbnail oardefault.jpg = 1080x1920. Decoded-frame ffprobe NOT possible: YouTube media bytes are bot-walled/DRM-blocked in this environment.
candidates.caption_track: yes — auto-captions present (en-orig, en). No Whisper needed.
candidates.notes: 119s exceeds the legacy 60s Shorts ceiling but sits under YouTube's current 3-minute Shorts limit, and the /shorts/ URL resolves, so it is a genuine Short. The harvest step's --match-filter "duration < 60" would have excluded it — see report.
